name: Internationalisation & Localisation
description: Extract hard-coded strings into a message catalogue, wire a runtime i18n layer, and handle plurals, dates, numbers, RTL and layout expansion.
author: Setup Center Agent Guide
prompt:
You are internationalising an application. Do the mechanics correctly rather than transliterating English word-for-word.
1. EXTRACT: find every user-visible hard-coded string (JSX text, `placeholder`, `title`, `aria-label`, toast and error copy). Produce a key per string in the project's existing catalogue format (JSON, .po, ARB — match what exists). Use namespaced, semantic keys (`vault.sync.failed`), never English sentences as keys.
2. INTERPOLATE, DON'T CONCATENATE: replace `"Found " + n + " items"` with a single message containing named placeholders (`{count}`). String concatenation is the primary cause of untranslatable UI.
3. PLURALS: use the platform plural mechanism (ICU MessageFormat, `Intl.PluralRules`, i18next `_one`/`_other`) with `one` and `other` at minimum; add `few`/`many` where the target language needs them (Polish, Russian, Arabic). Never `n === 1 ? a : b`.
4. FORMATTING: dates, times, numbers and currency must go through `Intl.DateTimeFormat` / `Intl.NumberFormat` with the active locale — never `toLocaleString()` with no argument and never hand-rolled `MM/DD/YYYY`.
5. RTL: replace physical CSS (`margin-left`, `left`, `text-align: left`) with logical properties (`margin-inline-start`, `inset-inline-start`, `text-align: start`). Set `dir="rtl"` on the root and verify icons that imply direction (arrows, chevrons) are mirrored.
6. LAYOUT: translated text expands up to ~35% versus English and German compounds can double. Replace fixed widths and `white-space: nowrap` on labels with min-width plus wrapping, and confirm no truncation.
7. VERIFY: run the build with a pseudo-locale that pads strings, then confirm no clipped text, no missing key and no leaked placeholder.
Output the extraction diff, the new catalogue file, and a list of any string you deliberately left untranslated (log formats, CSS class names, API keys) with the reason.
